title: Implement model-backed Safety classification authority
evidence_required: Focused deterministic classifier and PostgreSQL persistence test results.
Migration/model evidence for exact classification constraints, UUID relations, and absence of raw candidate storage.
Concurrency evidence for identical duplicate and conflicting first-write-wins behavior.
Outbound-spy evidence that the provider receives only SafetyGateProviderRequestV1 fields and no authorization/evidence data.
If credentialed UAT is run, safe model/classification refs proving one real non-fallback safety_gate call without secrets or raw output.
purpose: Add the canonical real model-backed safety_gate path that semantically classifies validated pending MessageEnvelope data while keeping the backend-validated, immutable PostgreSQL result as the only downstream routing authority.
success_outcome: One explicitly bound real safety_gate returns only the strict candidate union; backend validation persists exactly one authoritative SafetyClassificationResultV1 plus the nullable closed action kind, identical retries are idempotent, provider/invalid/uncertain branches become only blocked_uncertain for the later generic notice route, conflicting retries have no effect, current authorization/archive races write nothing, and no raw candidate, approval, task, Bus/UI publication, Timeline event, or actuation authority is created by this slice.
anti_goals: Do not implement pH/EC Safety evaluation, pending proposal projection, human approval, action tasks, follow-up, or outcomes in this task.
Do not create a public Safety Gate endpoint, dedicated Timeline event, fallback provider, fake runtime path, or raw candidate/provider persistence.
Do not let the provider construct or select the authoritative SafetyClassificationResultV1.

forbidden_scope: FT-012 approval, action_task, completion, follow-up, or outcome persistence.
Automated device commands or control integrations.
ChatGPT/Codex credential stores, default provider/model selection, or cross-provider fallback.
stop_conditions: The shared SafetyClassificationResultV1 matrix conflicts with the implementation baseline or would need widening.
A real classifier cannot be wired without sending authorization/evidence data outside the canonical request allowlist.
The implementation would require raw candidate persistence, a public API, or FT-012-owned state.
The current migration head or existing uncommitted work makes a safe additive classification migration ambiguous.

constraints: The provider receives only SafetyGateProviderRequestV1 and returns only SafetyGateModelCandidateV1; backend validation constructs the authoritative shared result.
classifier_version is safety_gate_v1 and the physical action kind is the exact ten-value closed union.
Provider I/O occurs outside database transactions; the current authorization and active-Plant guard is repeated in the classification write transaction.
The first committed message_id classification is immutable; a different retry fingerprint has no write or downstream route.
Raw candidate text, provider requests/responses, prompts, reasoning, credentials, and auth state are not persisted or exposed in evidence.
invariants: Model-selected labels and output never become Safety, publication, task, approval, or action authority.
Not-configured, provider-failed, invalid-output, and uncertainty branches fail closed as blocked_uncertain only when the durable current guard succeeds.
Archived or unauthorized Plant state creates no classification effect and restore never replays the handoff.
No fake, canned, hardcoded, fallback, or skipped result satisfies REQ-011 product-agent acceptance.
verification_targets: All strict request/candidate/shared-result matrix rows and unknown-field rejections pass in tests/backend/safety_gate/test_classifier.py.

PostgreSQL read/write smoke proves an authoritative safety_classifications row round-trips with exact UUIDs, enums, fingerprints, and no raw candidate column; all existing exact-head regression assertions advance to the W1 classification revision.
Concurrent identical and conflicting classification attempts prove first-write-wins immutability and no downstream effect on conflict.
Pre/post-provider current authorization, grant revocation, and archive races make no unauthorized durable row or restore replay.
Outbound request snapshots and safe evidence contain no Farm/Plant/auth/evidence fields, credentials, prompts, raw response, or hidden reasoning.
An explicitly requested real-model smoke makes exactly one selected DeepSeek/Gemini call and cannot pass by skip, fake output, fallback, or blocked/failed result.
